name: n6-return-pickup-window-environment
description: Runtime for scheduling return merchandise pickup appointments.

tools.lookup_return: Finds a return case and records return_found.
tools.schedule_pickup: Requires return_found, schedules a pickup, records pickup_scheduled, and sets pickup_days to at least 5.
tools.notify_customer: Requires pickup_scheduled, notifies the customer, and records customer_notified.
